label: lem:trace-sum-roots
title: Trace as sum of charpoly roots, over $\mathbb{C}$
statement:
Let $V$ be an additive commutative group with a $\mathbb{C}$-module structure satisfying \verb|[FiniteDimensional ℂ V]|, and let $f : V \to_{\ell} V$.  Then
  \[
    \mathrm{tr}_{\mathbb{C}}\,V\,f \; = \; f.\mathrm{charpoly}.\mathrm{roots}.\mathrm{sum}.
  \]
proof: This is \verb|Module.End.trace_eq_sum_roots_charpoly_of_splits|, applied with the hypothesis that the characteristic polynomial splits over $\mathbb{C}$.  Splitting is automatic because $\mathbb{C}$ is algebraically closed (\verb|Complex.isAlgClosed| together with \verb|IsAlgClosed.splits_codomain|).  The lemma's signature uses \verb|Module.Free| and \verb|Module.Finite| typeclasses; both follow from the explicit \verb|[FiniteDimensional ℂ V]| hypothesis (a finite-dimensional vector space over a field has a basis, hence is free, and is automatically finite as a module).
